label: A source with only being against the q.7 a.1 bridge: controls
paraphrase: Closed finite profile; statements about it only. A source that is its own being and has only being, and a received effect that has everything; two stand-in determinations, both pure. Role reading (only what is received is limited): own being is no recipient and limitation is only through reception, but unlimited esse does not have every pure perfection and the source lacks the stand-in for life. Measure reading: unlimited esse has every pure perfection, but the source is limited without being received, so limitation only through reception fails. A quantifier-view source fails one premise of the bridge on each reading.
